high_level_description: The image shows a person sitting on a ledge against a wooden wall with vertical slats. The individual is wearing a light gray hoodie with a colorful embroidered patch of a cartoonish bear on the left side of the chest. They have long, dark hair that falls over their shoulders and are wearing glasses. The person is holding a black disposable coffee cup to their mouth, suggesting they are drinking from it. The person is dressed casually in blue jeans that are slightly rolled up at the cuffs.
